description.value: Batch is an outdoor pub with multiple Vancouver locations, including a year-round Kitsilano outpost and seasonal plazas at Ambleside and the Plaza of Nations. The venue leans heavily on atmosphere — fire pits, food trucks, local brews, hot cider, and live music every day of the week. It is dog-friendly and draws a relaxed neighbourhood crowd, making it a reasonable rest stop for cyclists exploring the Kitsilano or waterfront areas.
